note: Runtime-loaded affiliate network metadata. Each entry describes a network's disclosure label, subid policy, and link-building behavior. Adding a new network requires ONLY editing this file — no recompile. The 'subid_policy' field controls what value is placed in the affiliate subid/cuid slot: 'merchant_host' (coarse, non-identifying — the destination host only), 'none' (no subid at all), or 'category' (a coarse product category, never user-identifying). The 'disclosure_label' is the human-readable text the frontend should show next to every affiliate-decorated result for this network.
